input: Requests through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc-db-broker), which hands this table module its connection: publish or read the filmstrip or wave record of a clip, forget the artifacts of clips about to leave the catalog.
output: The filmstrip_artifacts, filmstrip_frames and wave_artifacts tables of the project database and their public views. It creates only its own tables, writes no other (authorizer), reads the clip catalog through qnc-content-read (the clip exists; a wave belongs to its stored original or proxy; only a detected or failed clip is forgotten). Moved unchanged from qnc-content-store (lego split B5, user rule 2026-09-27).
specification: contracts/databases/timeline-artifacts.database.json; AGENTS section 8 (filmstrip JPEG files, wave peaks in the project database).
